Amounts presented above include share-based compensation expense of $0.8 million for fiscal year 2017, which is recorded as discontinued operations

As of September 27, 2019, the total unrecognized compensation costs related to outstanding stock options, restricted stock awards and units including awards
with time-based, performance-based, and market-based vesting was $47.0 million, which we expect to recognize over a weighted-average period of 2.9 years.
